The '''''Fireborn''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigate]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hunor]]. In [[44 ABY]], it was transferring [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] rebel leader [[Grunel Ovin]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but before got there it was blown up above Coruscant as an act of [[Death/Legends|suicide]] in order to draw attention to his [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Liberation|rebellion]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. This act of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] was actually secretly perpetrated by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hunor]] authorized by Galactic Alliance [[Chief of Naval Operations]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sallinor Parova]].
